items.title: GPU Rightsizing Without Breaking Production: G5, G6, P4, P5 and the CUDA Check Nobody Mentions
items.summary_en: AWS GPU rightsizing should start by matching workload type to the correct family—G5/G6 instances (A10G/L4 GPUs) for inference and graphics, P4/P5 (A100/H100) for large-scale training—with the most common waste being inference workloads running on expensive P-family instances. Rightsize based on GPU utilization and VRAM usage (typically via nvidia-smi or CloudWatch GPU metrics) rather than CPU, and always verify CUDA driver/library compatibility before switching families to avoid outages. Compound savings further by scheduling non-production GPU fleets to scale down during off-hours.

items.title: Prototype and Port: The Best Way to Use Claude for Personal Projects
items.summary_en: The article outlines a workflow for using Claude to add features to complex projects by prototyping first in a minimal environment before porting to the real codebase. Using a 1500-line HTML beat-maker web app (famous-beats-maker) with 70 presets as an example, the author demonstrated five steps: ask Claude about the data structure, add command-line arguments for testing, write a standalone replacement script, map prototype elements to the web app equivalents, and finally provide Claude full context to implement the feature in the production code.

items.title: DietrichGebert/ponytail
items.summary_en: Ponytail is an AI agent skill that applies a seven-rung decision ladder—prioritizing reuse, stdlib, native features, and minimal implementation—to dramatically reduce code output. Benchmarked on real Claude Code sessions editing a FastAPI + React repo, it cut lines of code by ~54% (up to 94%), reduced costs by ~20%, and sped up execution by ~27%, all while maintaining 100% safety compared to baseline approaches.

items.title: anthropics/claude-plugins-official
items.summary_en: Anthropic has launched an official, curated directory of high-quality Claude Code Plugins, featuring both internal plugins developed by Anthropic and third-party community plugins. Plugins are installed via the command `/plugin install {plugin-name}@claude-plugins-official` or through the `/plugin > Discover` interface, and follow a standard structure with metadata in `.claude-plugin/plugin.json`, MCP server configuration, commands, agents, and skills. External plugin submissions must meet quality and security standards, and skill-bundle plugins can expose `SKILL.md` files directly via a marketplace entry using `strict: false`.

items.title: AgriciDaniel/claude-obsidian
items.summary: claude-obsidian 是一个基于 Claude Code 的本地优先知识管理系统，可将来源材料自动转化为带引用标注的 Markdown 笔记并构建链接知识库。其核心流程为：通过 inbox 捕获来源→用 source/claim ledgers 验证每个重要声明→建立链接页面和地图→支持查询、研究和检索复用。安装需克隆仓库后运行 `python3 scripts/claude-obsidian.py init <vault路径>` 初始化独立 vault，并提供预览 plan 再申请的方式确保操作可追溯。
items.summary_en: claude-obsidian is an open-source, local-first knowledge system that integrates Obsidian with Claude Code to automatically transform source material into a connected, source-cited Markdown knowledge graph. It follows a repeatable loop—capture with context, ground claims via source ledgers, link notes with Maps of Content and Canvas views, and enable retrieval—while ensuring vault ownership remains with the user. Built on Karpathy's LLM Wiki pattern, it prevents race conditions through a single orchestrator and outputs plain Markdown for portability outside the agent.

items.title: The Compliance Stack Nobody Talks About
items.summary: AI 代理通过 Python 脚本调用 GSTN 沙盒 API  nightly 拉取 GSTR-2B 数据并与内部采购账簿匹配，自动生成带置信度分数的预填充 GSTR-3B，将原本 3 小时的税务对账缩减为 15 分钟的异常处理。系统结合 Claude 或 GPT-4o 进行账簿解读与异常标记，并配合规则引擎（如 194C/194J/194Q 分类）实现 TDS 章节归类，其中 LLM 对复杂 TDS 分类的准确率约为 90%。
items.summary_en: Indian startups are adopting AI agents that automate GST and TDS compliance by pulling GSTR-2B data from GSTN sandbox APIs nightly, matching ledgers, flagging ITC mismatches, and generating pre-filled GSTR-3B with confidence scores, cutting 3 hours of reconciliation work down to 15 minutes. The typical stack combines Python scripts, Claude or GPT-4o for ledger interpretation, and rule engines for TDS classification, achieving ~90% accuracy on the hardest task—distinguishing between TDS sections like 194C and 194J—with a working prototype buildable by a single developer in a weekend. As the CBDT moves toward faceless compliance and automated mismatch flagging, startups with internal automation now will hold a significant operational advantage within three years.

items.title: anthropics/claude-plugins-community
items.summary: Anthropics 官方维护的 Claude 社区插件市场仓库，收录面向 Claude Cowork 和 Claude Code 的插件，每晚从审核流水线同步至 marketplace.json。所有插件经 claude.ai 提交并通过自动化安全扫描。用户可通过 `claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-community` 添加源，再使用 `claude plugin install <plugin-name>@claude-community` 安装指定插件。
items.summary_en: The `anthropics/claude-plugins-community` repo is a read-only, nightly-synced mirror of the community plugin marketplace for Claude Cowork and Claude Code. All listed plugins pass automated security scanning and are approved through Anthropic's internal review pipeline via claude.ai. To install, users run `claude plugin marketplace add anthropics/claude-plugins-community` followed by `claude plugin install <plugin-name>@claude-community`, or browse directly at claude.com/plugins.
